_comment: AMD Alveo V80 device profile for AutoHLS_Flow. Deployment backend: SLASH/VRT (not Vitis OpenCL).
name: Alveo_V80
deployment_note: Alveo V80 uses SLASH Segmented Configuration flow with VRT runtime. Physical deployment requires SLASH/AVED initialization. Use 'python integrations/slash/export_to_slash.py' to generate SLASH project.
platform_note: V80 does NOT use xclbin/OpenCL. platform_string is null by design.
